prompt: We run a consumer app with several location-related settings. What does the September 2026 Google decision mean for how we design them?
assertions: Cites the decision: the Irish DPC fined Google Ireland €403,000,000 (final September 21, 2026) as lead supervisory authority
Identifies the processing: location data across Web & App Activity, Location History and Location Accuracy
States the findings across the ladder: unlawful/unfair processing, transparency failures (Arts. 12/13), accountability gaps, and retention longer than necessary — Arts. 5, 6, 12, 13
Mentions the 6-month compliance order (and treats any appeal as reported, not confirmed)
Draws design lessons: each location feature needs its own lawful basis, specific transparency and retention limits — bundled 'improve your experience' framing across settings is the failure pattern
